Bhagavad Gita, Chapter 3, Verse 7

“But one who restrains the senses with the mind, Arjuna, and undertakes karma yoga with the organs of action, unattached — that one excels.”

The alternative, stated as a straight comparison. Same senses, same work, but the order is reversed: mind governing the senses instead of trailing along behind them.
